existing.selection_notes: The application process and decision-making are managed individually by each partner university and non-governmental organisation, not by the Mastercard Foundation. Admission to a partner university does not guarantee selection for the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program, which the Foundation states is highly competitive. There is no limit to the number of partner universities an applicant may apply to, but each application is a substantial submission and may carry a fee.
existing.best_fit: Young people from underrepresented backgrounds in Africa seeking secondary, undergraduate or master's study at a Mastercard Foundation partner university or through a partner NGO, who can apply through that partner's own admissions process.
existing.notes: There is no central application, no central deadline and no central eligibility test, so a record of this scholarship cannot tell you whether a specific window is open. You must check each partner institution's own programme page for its deadline. Many partners require an admission application fee that the Foundation states will be reimbursed if you are selected, so do not let the fee stop you applying. The Foundation warns publicly that there are Facebook posts and groups advertising recruitment for this programme and requesting an application fee, and states that these groups are not associated with the Mastercard Foundation; the Foundation does not solicit funding or request payments from individuals. Report suspected fraud to local law enforcement and to ethics@mastercardfdn.org. PhD and doctoral candidates are not currently eligible. The Foundation does not provide financial support to candidates who are not awarded a scholarship through this programme. The Foundation is not currently accepting unsolicited partnership proposals.
existing.duration: Programme period published as August 2012 to ongoing; duration is set by each partner institution's degree programme
existing.application_period: No central application window. The programme is published as active and ongoing from August 2012, and applications are accepted on each partner institution's own admissions schedule.
existing.deadline_display: Each partner in the Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program sets their own deadline. Please check the Program website of the partner institution(s) of your choice for the specific deadline.
existing.program_type: Foundation scholarship administered through partner institutions
